problem:
If
    $H=[\begin{aligned}u & -v & -x & y\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $H.$

|  |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${H}^{T}=\,\,$ |  | {{field-2}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-3}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-4}} |  |
worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{H}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}u \\ -v \\ -x \\ y\end{aligned}]
$$
